# Test fixtures

Golden files and sample data live here, one directory per phase or parser.

- Phase 2: Greenbook export samples and leaflet PDFs.
- Phase 3: small pack photos used by the scan pipeline tests (`images/`).
- Phase 4: label photo fixtures for validators and provider contract tests
  (`internal/vision/testdata/`). The real 100-photo eval set is kept separately
  for consent reasons; see `eval/README.md`.

Fixtures never contain real user images or personal data (see
../docs/data-handling.md).
